jobs.description:

Key responsibilities
Lead the PMU-Solar, establish the integrated execution programme, monitor milestones, expenditure, quality, risks and corrective actions for rooftop and utility-scale PV, associated BESS and plant-level C&C/SCADA.
Oversee formal takeover of solar-project records, ongoing procurements and contractual obligations from W&PD GB, including Rooftop Lots I & II, Lot III and applicable consultancy contracts, through duly approved arrangements.

Prepare or coordinate reporting to PPIB, Power Division, the Steering Committee and Planning Commission, including progress, PC-III/RBM information, completion/PC-IV inputs and audit responses.
Prepare annual cash and work plans before commencement of each financial year and oversee the operation and management of project accounts in accordance with applicable financial rules and approved arrangements.
Regularly update project progress in the prescribed Planning Commission reporting systems, including PMES/iPAS, as applicable, and prepare quarterly and annual progress reports.
Establish performance indicators for PMU-Solar personnel and periodically evaluate their performance.
Ensure proper maintenance and custody of all project documents, accounts, assets, contractual records and audit reports.
Exercise delegated administrative, functional and financial powers in accordance with applicable rules and remain

jobs.title: Manager Strategy and Partnerships
jobs.description:
Role Overview:
The Manager - Strategy and Partnerships will support PSEB's international market development, strategic partnerships and export promotion agenda to increase Pakistan's IT & IT-Enabled Services (ITeS) exports. The position will focus on identifying international buyers and partners, preparing and executing country-specific market plans, developing qualified commercial opportunities and tracking outcomes throughout the year. The Manager will work with Pakistani IT companies, foreign missions, Trade & Investment Counsellors (TICs), diaspora networks, industry associations, development partners and international organizations. This is a market development and partnerships role, distinct from the logistical delivery of events and delegations. The role reports to the Director, Business Development & Partnerships.

Minimum 16 years of education in Business Administration, Marketing, International Relations, Economics, Management, Public Policy or a related field.
Candidates from other academic disciplines with relevant professional experience directly related to the experience requirements and responsibilities of this role are also encouraged to apply.
Degree(s) must be from a HEC-recognized national or international university/institution.
Experience:
Minimum 10 years of total professional experience, including at least 05 years of relevant post-qualification experience in business development, strategic partnerships, corporate strategy, international trade, market development, management consulting, account management, client relations or related functions.
Experience gained in the private sector, public institutions or other industries will be considered based on relevant transferable skills. Experience working with government institutions or public-sector organizations will be preferred but not mandatory.
Demonstrated ability in relationship development, market analysis, negotiation, stakeholder management and commercial opportunity development is required.
Experience in IT & ITeS, export promotion, international client engagement or B2B/G2B/G2G engagements will be considered an advantage, not a mandatory requirement.

jobs.title: Director General
jobs.description:
Strategic Leadership & Governance
Formulate and execute CDNS's multi-year strategic plan aligned with the DMO’s, Medium Term Debt Strategy and FRDL Act(as amended from time to time).
Serve as the Director General and administrative head of CDNS, responsible for overall institutional performance.
Serve as a member of the Steering Committee to Review Implementation of Strategic Realignment of CDNS and present strategic plans for consultation, discussion and implementation of key decisions of the Steering Committee.
Provide strategic oversight of all functional directorates: HR, Operations, Legal, Audit & Inspection, Product Development & Management and any other CDNS directorates.
Propose creation and restructuring of organizational units to improve efficiency and service delivery.
Define, assign, and periodically review job descriptions for all posts of CDNS.
Financial Management & Budgetary Oversight
Exercise sanctioning authority over expenditures in accordance with powers conferred under General Financial Rules (GFR).
Lead the preparation and submission of proposals for the administrative budget to Finance Division through the CF&AO.
Submit proposals on investment, repayment, and interest budgets to Finance Division.
Drive the achievement of assigned budgetary investment targets.
Propose revisions to rates of return on national savings schemes based on macroeconomic and market analysis.
Product Development & Scheme Management
Lead the design and launch of new savings instruments and products.
Work actively with the Director, Domestic Debt, DMO, on product pricing and product launch to align CDNS’s funding with overall MTDS.
Oversee NSS rules and any amendments thereof.
Monitor performance of existing savings schemes and recommend modifications to enhance investor appeal and fiscal efficiency.
Human Resource Management
Function as appointing authority for employees in BPS 3–16.
Exercise disciplinary authority over employees in BPS 3–16 under the E&D Rules.
Manage all HR matters for BPS 17–19 officers (excluding appointment and disciplinary cases reserved for the competent authority).
Drive a culture of meritocracy, accountability, and continuous professional development across CDNS.
Initiate talent development programs and succession planning for leadership roles.
Digital Transformation & Technology
Lead CDNS's digital transformation agenda, including the development and rollout of online savings platforms and mobile banking interfaces.

Oversee the admission process, including the admission test conducted through FBISE or another designated body.
Introduce modern pedagogy, STEAM, digital learning and AI-enabled personalised learning in Daanish Schools.
Ensure safe, healthy and child-protective residential (boarding) environments.
